title: Forensic
finance
tagline: Other people's books, tangled ownership structures, disputes — and the search for facts somebody tried to hide.

blocks.label: What I saw
blocks.text: Fraud shows up as a break in the usual pattern. So you first reconstruct how this particular business normally works, and only then compare that picture against reality.

blocks.label: What I built
blocks.text: Sixteen years of working with data: financial analytics and expert work in companies I was seeing for the first time. I reconstructed money flows, untangled ownership structures and wrote conclusions that could survive hostile scrutiny. In parallel, eight years as part-time general manager of an audit and consulting firm.

blocks.label: Result
blocks.text: One approach underlies all of it: get into an unfamiliar domain, understand how it works, find the anomaly. After 2022 I have applied the same approach to data systems instead of ledgers.
